mapping_reviews.reason: Article 15 relates to the scope of the AI Act and does not address cybersecurity processes.
Article 17 covers the obligations of providers of general-purpose AI models and does not address cybersecurity processes.
Article 20 addresses the obligations of distributors and does not address cybersecurity processes.
Article 73 relates to the European Artificial Intelligence Board and does not address cybersecurity processes.

missing_mappings.reason: Article 28 requires high-risk AI systems to have an appropriate level of cybersecurity, which includes vulnerability, patching, detection, response, and serious-incident processes.

applicability_note: The control statement is applicable to all AI systems, but the reporting requirement is specific to high-risk AI systems.
challenge_comment: The existing mappings are incorrect as they do not relate to cybersecurity processes. The correct mapping is to Article 28, which specifically addresses cybersecurity requirements for high-risk AI systems.
